facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.
Dr. Uriah's Read Languages spell reveals the writing under one treasure-map location per day.

A location on the map is labelled "Dragon's lair"; Grimny says Bral, who gave the party the map, probably hid the treasure there, in a very small one-room cave the dwarves once scouted as a hiding place and found empty.
What is the third marked location on the treasure map? Sir Phidipaldi guesses King Hogboon's, though the goblins' temple-castle lies near an unmarked area of the map.
The treasure probably lies in the Dragon's Lair, where the dragon the party is hunting may be found, though Dunk suspects there is no dragon and only Bral keeping people away.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the dragon actually occupies the cave; Dunk speculates there is no dragon.
